scene_description: Interior of an open light-wood cabinet shelf with a hinged door on the left side and a top panel overhead. A Mastermind board game box and a blue poker-chip tin lie flat on a printed sheet of paper with a QR code, and a blue-capped Expo marker lies at the back. Directional terms (front, back, left, right) refer to the view in 01.jpg, looking into the cabinet from the front.

targets.name: Expo marker
targets.description: Blue-capped dry-erase (Expo) marker lying on its side at the rear of the shelf, directly behind the blue poker-chip tin and close to the back panel, just right of the upper end of the Mastermind box.
nearby_obstacles: Poker chip tin directly in front of it
Mastermind box close on its left
Cabinet back panel directly behind it
targets.clearance_notes: Very small cylindrical object resting on the paper sheet, pinned between the back panel and the tin with little room to approach from the front.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the poker chip tin approximately 10 cm to the right so the marker is visible and accessible from the front.
Move the marker approximately 10 cm toward the front of the shelf, away from the back panel.

targets.other_notes: Only 1.5 cm in diameter; recorded dimensions are as provided, with the 14 cm length shown as depth.

targets.name: Board game box
targets.description: Black-and-white 'Mastermind' board game box lying flat and rotated diagonally on the left side of the shelf, partly resting on the edge of the white paper sheet, with its left end close to the left cabinet side panel and the blue poker tin immediately to its right.
nearby_obstacles: Left cabinet side panel close to its left end
Poker chip tin immediately to its right
Top panel of the cabinet overhead
targets.clearance_notes: Long, thin box with its left end near the side panel and the tin close on the right; the front of the shelf is open.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the box approximately 5 cm away from the left side panel to create more clearance.
Move the box approximately 10 cm toward the front of the shelf so its long edge is exposed at the shelf lip.

targets.name: Poker chip tin
targets.description: Blue rectangular poker-chip tin (with chips, cards, and dice printed on the lid) lying flat on the printed paper sheet at the right-center of the shelf, in front of the blue-capped marker and to the right of the Mastermind box.
nearby_obstacles: Mastermind box close on its left
targets.clearance_notes: Open shelf space in front and to the right; the Mastermind box is close on the left side.
targets.other_notes: Resting on the paper sheet, which may slide when the tin is moved.
